author: Page, Scourfield, et al.

steps.title: Acid wash silica particles
steps.instruction: Suspend 21 g silicon dioxide (325 mesh, Sigma 342890) in 40 mL 10 % HCl in a 50 mL polypropylene tube, agitate for 4 h on a tube roller (or invert 10 times every 10 min), centrifuge at 2,000 g for 5 min, then remove the HCl with a pipette and store it for reuse.

substeps.instruction: Suspend 21 g silicon dioxide in 40 mL 10 % HCl in a 50 mL polypropylene tube
Agitate for 4 h on a tube roller (or invert every 10 min if no roller)
Centrifuge at 2,000 g for 5 min
Remove HCl with a pipette and store in a double‑container for reuse

steps.title: First water wash of silica
steps.instruction: Resuspend the silica pellet in 40 mL deionized water, vortex (~134 × g) or tap to mix, centrifuge at 2,000 g for 5 min, and discard the wash water.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend pellet in 40 mL deionized water
Vortex at ~134 × g or tap to ensure no HCl remains trapped
Centrifuge at 2,000 g for 5 min
Discard wash water (flush with plenty of water)

steps.title: Repeat water washes (total 6)
steps.instruction: Repeat the water‑wash procedure five additional times for a total of six washes, discarding each wash.

substeps.instruction: Repeat the resuspend‑centrifuge‑discard cycle five more times for a total of six washes

steps.title: Check and adjust pH of final wash
steps.instruction: Measure the pH of the supernatant with a strip; it must be 7–8. If acidic, perform additional water washes and re‑measure until the pH is within 7–8.

substeps.instruction: Measure pH of the supernatant with a pH strip (target 7–8)
If pH is below 7, perform extra water washes and re‑measure until pH reaches 7–8

steps.title: Finalize silica suspension
steps.instruction: Remove the final supernatant, confirming the pellet is white, then resuspend the silica in 30 mL RNase‑free water.

substeps.instruction: Remove the supernatant; pellet should appear white
Resuspend silica in a final volume of 30 mL H₂O (preferably Milli‑Q or RNase‑free)

steps.title: Aliquot glassmilk and store
steps.instruction: Aliquot the glassmilk into clean 1.5 mL tubes and store at 16 °C–40 °C (stable for at least 18 months).

substeps.instruction: Aliquot the suspension into clean 1.5 mL tubes
Store tubes at 16 °C–40 °C

steps.title: Prepare 1.25 M NaCl solution
steps.instruction: Weigh 36.525 g NaCl (Sigma/Merck S3014‑500G), dissolve in 500 mL water, and store at 16 °C–40 °C (stable ≥6 months).

substeps.instruction: Weigh 36.525 g NaCl
Dissolve in 500 mL H₂O
Store at 16 °C–40 °C

steps.title: Prepare 70 % ethanol
steps.instruction: Mix 350 mL pure ethanol (Fisher 10644795) with 150 mL water to make 500 mL 70 % EtOH; keep in the dark at 16 °C–40 °C.

substeps.instruction: Combine 350 mL pure ethanol with 150 mL water
Store the 500 mL solution in the dark at 16 °C–40 °C

steps.title: Prepare 4 % SDS solution
steps.instruction: From a 10 % SDS stock, mix 200 mL 10 % SDS (Fisher 10552785) with 300 mL water to obtain 500 mL of 4 % SDS; keep at 16 °C–40 °C and warm if precipitation occurs.

substeps.instruction: Mix 200 mL 10 % SDS stock with 300 mL water
Store at 16 °C–40 °C; warm and re‑dissolve if precipitation is observed

steps.title: Set up extraction controls
steps.instruction: For each extraction include a positive control (laboratory‑grown virus) and a negative extraction control (H₂O); perform all steps at ambient temperature (16 °C–40 °C) unless otherwise noted.

substeps.instruction: Add a positive extraction control (lab‑grown virus) and a negative control (H₂O) to each batch
Carry out all steps at ambient temperature (16 °C–40 °C) unless a different temperature is specified
